name: Savra
description: An elf who freed Svogthir, built him a new body, then betrayed him and took leadership of the Golgari.

description_citations.text: "Svogthir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra directs the planting of Golgari dead in a dark sanctuary.
timeline.quote: Plant our brethren here. This shall be our sanctuary.

citation.text: Dark Heart of the Wood (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Savra declares the dead move to necromancy's hollow rhythm.
timeline.quote: All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy.

citation.text: Macabre Waltz (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
timeline.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Decamillennial, quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla attack the Center on Savra's orders.
timeline.quote: the Center was attacked by quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra's death and Jarad's succession end the Golgari attack and force a withdrawal.
timeline.quote: Only the death of Savra and the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo , ultimately brought the Golgari attack to an end

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra mixes quietmen among the Selesnyans and infects the roots of Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: She had mixed her quietmen among the Selesnyans

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek snaps Savra's neck and kills the dryads of the Chorus linked with her.
timeline.quote: Savra’s ally turned on her in an instant, snapping her neck

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Evern's partners sold dragon fluid to Lyzolda; they meet contractor Momir Vig and partners Szadek and Savra.
timeline.quote: they sold some of the dragon's liquid to Lyzolda , the acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 6". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Evern warns Kos and Augustin that Momir Vig and the Simic work with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.
timeline.quote: Evern Capobar shows up to warn them about Momir Vig and the Simic, who are working together with the God-Zombie Svogthir who was inhabiting the body of Savra.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowering Svogthir, and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
timeline.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jarad saves Fonn from Savra's assassination plot against Bayul.
timeline.quote: Fonn was saved by the bounty hunter Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra's quietmen abduct Fonn and Savra rips off her hand when she refuses to give up the gem.
timeline.quote: the matka ripped her whole hand off.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra, helped by Szadek, takes control of the guild, resurrects Svogthir to overthrow the Sisters, and proclaims herself guildmaster.
timeline.quote: After this, Savra proclaimed herself as the new Golgari guildmaster.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra tries to infiltrate the Selesnya Conclave but is double-crossed by Szadek, who snaps her neck.
timeline.quote: she was double-crossed by Szadek, who snapped her neck to weaken the Conclave.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Dissension, Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother Jarad, who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates Savra and the Selesnya Conclave into killing Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: manipulating Savra and the Selesnya Conclave to do his bidding and kill Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Guildpact's Decamillennial anniversary, Savra frees Svogthir and builds him a new body, which he uses to defeat the Sisters, killing two more.
timeline.quote: She freed Svogthir from his tomb and constructed a new body for him

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra betrays Svogthir, takes control of his body, cuts off his head, consumes his essence, and mounts his skull on her staff.
timeline.quote: cutting off his head, and consuming his essence to empower herself

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek murders Savra, Svogthir's spirit takes over her corpse and allies with Momir Vig to use Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Svogthir's spirit took over the treacherous elf 's corpse

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Last sighting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo
